This scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 神农和他的家人住在古代：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 因为他的家人常常生病了：常常生病，no了for routine/habit
- 他们去很多不一样的地方：去了，了completed

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 神农和他的家人住在古代：在古代，神农和他的家人生活，古代 is a time expression, not a place following 住在; place the time phrase before the clause instead. [rule: time_expression]
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，At the first mention, introduce the character with a name and a full noun phrase so the reader knows who he is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
3. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 常常生病了：常常生病，A habitual condition uses the zero particle; 了 is not used for a routine action. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他们去很多不一样的地方：他们去了很多不一样的地方，This narrative event is presented as completed, so use 了 after 去. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “住在古代” is acceptable Chinese for living in ancient times; treating 古代 as unable to follow 住在 is a false positive.
This is the first mention of 神农, so introducing him as “一个叫神农的人” follows the teacher’s first-reference rule.
常常 marks a habitual situation, so 生病 should not take completed-event 了.
The trip to many places is a completed narrative event, so 去了 is required.
